checks.text: The page heading is "Water Intake Tracker" and the default daily goal display shows "Goal: 2000 ml".
Typing "500" in the field labelled "Amount (ml)" and clicking the button "Log intake" adds a list item containing "500 ml" and the progress ring shows "500 / 2000 ml".
After logging "500" and then "750" in the field labelled "Amount (ml)", the progress ring shows "1250 / 2000 ml" and the list contains two items: "500 ml" and "750 ml".
Clicking the button "Delete 500 ml" removes that entry, leaving only "750 ml" in the list, and the progress ring updates to "750 / 2000 ml".
Changing the field labelled "Daily goal (ml)" to "2500" and clicking "Save goal" updates the goal display to "Goal: 2500 ml" and the progress ring denominator to "2500 ml".
Clicking the tab "Heatmap" shows a heatmap grid where the cell for today displays the total logged intake for the current day (e.g., "1250" if 500 and 750 were logged).
Clicking the tab "Trend" shows a trend chart with a data point for today equal to the sum of all logged amounts for the current day.
When the total logged intake for today reaches or exceeds the daily goal, the streak counter increments by 1 and displays "Streak: 1 day".

Reload keeps the logged entries and the custom goal: after logging "500" and setting the goal to "2500", reloading shows the list item "500 ml", the goal display "Goal: 2500 ml", and the progress ring "500 / 2500 ml".
